description: Engagement state.json for the Brownfield SAD Authoring Agent (workspace/<engagement_id>/brownfield-sad/state.json). Only engagement_id and last_valid_checkpoint are populated by the EPMCSAPAI-323 reconcile-brownfield-sad-state Tool today -- the remaining fields are forward-declared per the plan's full Engagement Workspace Contract and get populated once EPMCSAPAI-322 (Confluence) and EPMCSAPAI-327 (Agent behavior) land. The checkpoint files this state.json points at (checkpoints/CHK-<engagement_id>-<n>.json) are a separate, immutable per-artifact hash/review log written by the same Tool -- see documents[].checkpoint_ref below and template.md for that file's shape.

engagement_id.description: Stable engagement identifier; also the workspace/<engagement_id>/ directory name.

last_valid_checkpoint.description: Stable ID of the most recent successful checkpoint, e.g. CHK-<engagement_id>-3. null before the first commit.

confluence_root_page_id.description: Not yet populated (needs EPMCSAPAI-322). The approved Confluence root page under which the Canonical Confluence Document Layout's six pages live.

current_evidence_stage.description: Not yet populated (needs EPMCSAPAI-327). Which Brownfield Delivery Flow stage the engagement is currently at.

next_eligible_skill_ids.description: Not yet populated (needs EPMCSAPAI-327). Stable Skill IDs the Agent may invoke next.

adr_sync_status.description: Not yet populated (needs EPMCSAPAI-325/327). Engagement-level ADR Synchronization Protocol status.

documents.description: Not yet populated (needs EPMCSAPAI-322/327). One entry per tracked artifact instance -- the per-document reference record the plan's Engagement Workspace Contract requires.

checkpoint_ref.description: Stable checkpoint ID this document's last known hash/review state was recorded under.

conflict_ids.description: artifact_ids currently blocked on an unresolved conflict, per the last diff run.
